fast.trigger: owner-timing contract, collector, probe, or diagnostic make fragment changes

link.trigger: probe hierarchy, sample ABI, DPI signature, top-level elaboration, make fragment, or required config changes

workload_ab.trigger: first measurement release, workload or ROI change, simulator/device semantic change, or production/elaborated RTL change

refresh_policy.checker_only: versioned replay is permitted when frozen raw input, terminal evidence, and post-hash binding are complete
refresh_policy.production_or_elaboration_change: refresh affected functional evidence and stats-off/stats-on workload comparison
refresh_policy.review_only: no gate pointer and no task-run required
refresh_policy.candidate_delivery: implementer evidence followed by independent counterexample review
